channels_captured: Full multi-module DTC scan
purpose: Read every module's stored codes
summary: Four codes, all Archive (inactive): U0422 (OBD-II + engine control unit), U0140 (OCS), B11D8(14) (RCM). Zero P-codes of any kind. Owner confirmed no airbag warning light and that the scan covered all modules.

channels_captured: Full live-data value list (~11 screenshots): STFT B1/B2, LTFT B1/B2, lambda, AFR, knock retard, timing advance, cam advance, throttle desired/actual, catalyst temps both banks, ECT, control module voltage, OBD module voltage, battery voltage, battery SoC, commanded evaporative purge, ethanol fuel percent, MAF, RPM, tyre pressures, A/C pressure, monitor status
purpose: First live data of the project - snapshot of every supported channel at warm idle
summary: STFT B1 0.78-3.13 %, B2 0 %, LTFT 0.0 % both banks (probably un-relearned - 101 km / 3 warm-ups since clear), misfire monitor COMPLETED with DTC count 0, fuel system and catalyst monitors not completed, lambda 0.99, AFR 14.52, knock retard 0, timing 11.5 deg, cam at rest, throttle tracking within 0.27 deg, cat temps 458.9/458.9, ECT 94 C, charging 13.76-14.0 V, SoC 88 %, commanded purge 41 %, ethanol 16.08 %, MAF 2.93 g/s at 661 rpm, right front tyre 211.7 kPa.

channels_captured: Engine RPM (single channel)
purpose: First rpm stability capture - intended as the bare-idle baseline
summary: Six windows, spans 68/76/64/81/75/78 rpm, mean 650-660, body of the trace 638-668. Owner revealed afterwards the A/C was ON, so this is loaded idle, not a baseline. Assistant's first reading of the x-axis as wall-clock produced a '4-5 minute period, normal' verdict that was later withdrawn.

channels_captured: Engine RPM (single channel)
purpose: Bare-idle rpm baseline with A/C off, for comparison against P2S-003
summary: Five windows, spans 37/74/38/30/53 rpm around 650. One real load event: dip to 606-612 held briefly then overshoot to 680. Owner corrected the timebase here ('the data is not 15 minutes use mobile clock'), which converted the pattern into a 2.5-4 s rhythmic hunt with 4-6 cycles per ~15 s screen.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Short term fuel % trim - Bank 1
purpose: Set A - does fuel trim move with rpm, and which leads
summary: RPM avg 653 oscillating 40 rpm at 3.5-4 s. STFT B1 quantised in 0.78 % steps, never outside -1.56 to +1.56 %. Owner stated the gridlines are 5 seconds. App Avg values -0.92 to -0.17 recorded but inadmissible.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Commanded evaporative purge
purpose: Set B - is purge cycling in rhythm with the rpm
summary: Purge flat at 40.78 % stepping down one LSB at a time to 40.00 over about two minutes; y-axis spans only 0.38 % so the full-height 'spikes' are rounding flicker between the adjacent codes 40.39 and 40.78. RPM band 24-34 rpm around 650 on a ~3 s rhythm, rpm axis 618-703. Includes the three extra screenshots the owner sent to show a suspected jump to 47 % (it was the mm:ss time axis). This session also produced the proof that the app's Min/Avg/Max fields are session-cumulative.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Throttle Position Actually
purpose: The discriminator - is the PCM moving the throttle, or is something disturbing the engine
summary: Throttle dead flat, min = max, at 7.15-7.24 deg on wide axes (6.20-8.24) in four windows while rpm swung 634-675. Apparent movement in other windows is 0.1-0.2 deg of monotonic drift on a zoomed axis. One deliberate blip at 55:14: throttle 22.68 deg, rpm to 705, undershoot to 630, clean settle.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Timing advance
purpose: Is the PCM trimming idle with spark instead of air
summary: Spark advance oscillates 10-13.5 deg in rhythm with rpm on a real 9.5-13.5 axis. Transient at 59:49: rpm 723 -> timing 6 deg, then rpm 614 -> timing 15 deg. The PCM holds idle with spark, which is why the throttle sat still.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Variable camshaft actual advance #1
purpose: Is a cam phaser oscillating at idle and modulating torque
summary: Axis spans 0 to -0.06 deg - two adjacent quantisation steps. Phaser parked, does not move. Intake bank 1 only.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + MAF air flow rate
purpose: With the throttle static, does the air actually entering the engine vary
summary: MAF ~3.01 g/s varying 0.05 g/s (~1.7 %) on a 2.97-3.08 axis while rpm swings 5.4 %. Essentially flat - consistent with choked flow through a fixed plate at idle.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Commanded throttle actuator
purpose: Is the PCM asking for throttle movement that a binding plate is not delivering
summary: Commanded flat at 1.57 %, min = max, on a wide 0.6-2.57 axis; later one LSB step to 1.18 % and flat again. Commanded and actual agree and both are static. RPM 623-674, period 3.5-4 s - the clearest rpm trace of the session.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Calculated engine load value
purpose: Independent cross-check on airflow
summary: Load oscillates with rpm at the same ~3.5 s period, about 1 percentage point on ~28 %, toggling 2-3 LSBs. Not an independent witness - calculated load is PCM arithmetic on MAF, rpm, baro and IAT.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Lambda + Air:fuel ratio
purpose: Is the actual mixture swinging even though the trim correction is flat
summary: Lambda 0.98-1.02, AFR 14.37-14.97, clean smooth sine at ~3.4 s - the same period as rpm. A +/-2 % mixture swing. This overturned the earlier 'fuel control eliminated' conclusion drawn from flat STFT.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + ECU voltage
purpose: Electrical instability tracking rpm
summary: Min 12.39, max 12.82, average 12.62-12.67 with the engine running, swinging 0.43 V p2p with rapid irregular spikes. Earlier in the same session the same truck read 13.76 / 14.0 / 13.8 V. Either Ford smart charging or the alternator has stopped; multimeter check deferred by the owner to the next day.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Fuel/Air commanded equivalence ratio
purpose: Is the PCM commanding the mixture swing, or is it happening for a physical reason
summary: Commanded ratio is a clean square wave toggling between exactly 14.41 and 14.86 with nothing in between, period 3.5-4 s. The PCM commands the dither; measured lambda is that square wave filtered by exhaust mixing and sensor response.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Oxygen sensor 2 Bank 1 Voltage
purpose: Is the bank 1 catalyst buffering the dither
summary: Downstream B1 swings 0.17-0.82 V in clean full-range sweeps at the same 3.5-4 s period, average 0.58-0.63. Sensor itself fast, transitions under a second. Catalyst temp 458 C after nearly an hour of idling.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Oxygen sensor 2 Bank 2 Voltage
purpose: Bank comparison against P2S-016
summary: Downstream B2 average 0.70-0.72 V, minima 0.30-0.39, maxima 0.80-0.83, biased high with shallower dips. Better than bank 1 but not flat. The only asymmetry found in the whole dataset.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + O2S1 air:fuel (Oxygen sensor 1 Wide Range Equivalence ratio)
purpose: Upstream bank 1 sensor speed and range
summary: Swings 14.41-15.05 AFR with clean transitions well under a second, tracking the commanded dither with the small overshoot expected from transport delay. Clears the 'cleaning made the sensors lazy' hypothesis on response speed.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + O2S5 air:fuel (Oxygen sensor 5 Wide Range Equivalence ratio)
purpose: Upstream bank 2 - does fuelling match bank 1
summary: 14.35-15.23 AFR, avg 14.66-14.70, same period and same clean fast transitions as bank 1. The 15.23/14.12 excursion coincides with an rpm spike to 715 at graph clock 4:32. RPM in these windows 616-679. Assistant concluded fuelling was symmetric - a conclusion overturned at [179] by the bank 2 trim.

channels_captured: Engine RPM + Short term fuel % trim - Bank 2
purpose: Bank 2 trim, the gap in the fuel picture
summary: Bank 2 STFT sits stepping between 3.13 and 3.91 % across all nine windows (true value ~+3.5 %) with excursions to 5.47 and 6.25 and dips to 1.56, against bank 1's ~0 %. Also settled the graph timebase beyond doubt: graph clock 21:20-23:55 (2 min 35 s) against phone clock 12:48-12:51 (~3 min), so the axis is MM:SS, gridlines 5 s, screen ~15 s.
